caption: This tonkotsu broth, creamy beige and glossy, floats with noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with a red checkered pattern, tender chashu pork and pale yellow menma sit beside a metallic spoon on a warm wooden table.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with browned edges and visible marbling, irregularly shaped.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
White ceramic bowl with red checkered pattern and "Sugakiya" logo along its rim.
A metallic spoon with a reflective surface, curved bowl, and slightly worn handle edge.
